# Crash Reporting — Version Identity at SDK Initialization

## Overview

Every crash report OmniTrain emits is tagged with `'unknown@unknown'` instead of the actual installed app version. The app collects the correct version via `PackageInfo` at startup and passes it to `CrashReportingService.bootstrap` via a `buildMetadata` closure, but `bootstrap` never forwards that metadata to `reporter.init`. A second gap means platform-originated failures (captured directly by the Sentry SDK, bypassing the app's `recordError` wrapper) carry no version, OS, or device identity at all, because those identifiers are currently set only per-event inside `recordError`.

## Requirements

- `bootstrap` must forward `buildMetadata()` to `reporter.init` so the Sentry SDK receives the correct app version at initialization.
- `SentryCrashReporter.init` must set OS version and device model as SDK-level scope tags (via `Sentry.configureScope`) so every event — including platform-originated ones — carries the full identity payload.
- The privacy contract is unchanged: permitted fields remain exactly `appVersion`, `osVersion`, `deviceModel`.
- When `PackageInfo.fromPlatform()` throws, the fallback version must be a distinct, greppable string (not `'0.0.0+0'` which looks like a real version).
- Debug and profile builds emit no reports and install no handlers.
- Startup must not fail or block if the Sentry SDK is unreachable.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] Every report emitted by a release build is labelled with the installed app version and build number.
- [x] Reports generated by platform-code failures carry the same app version, OS version, and device model as reports generated by app code.
- [x] No report carries the previous `'unknown@unknown'` placeholder unless `PackageInfo` genuinely failed.
- [x] When `PackageInfo` fails, reports are still sent and version label is `'version-unavailable+0'` (greppable, not plausible-looking).
- [x] Outgoing report fields are exactly `appVersion`, `osVersion`, `deviceModel` — no additional field.
- [x] Debug and profile builds emit no reports and install no handlers.
- [x] Startup does not fail or block if Sentry is unreachable.

## Scenarios

### S-001: Happy-path bootstrap with real version
- Trigger: App starts in release mode; `PackageInfo.fromPlatform()` succeeds
- Precondition: Sentry DSN is set; `kReleaseMode` is true
- Flow: `main()` calls `PackageInfo.fromPlatform()`, builds `appVersion`, calls `CrashReportingService.bootstrap` with `buildMetadata` closure, `bootstrap` calls `reporter.init(enabled: true, metadata: buildMetadata())`
- Expected outcome: `reporter.init` receives `metadata` containing the real version; `SentryCrashReporter` sets `options.release` to real version and sets OS/device scope tags
- Edge case of: none

### S-002: Platform version lookup fails — fallback label
- Trigger: `PackageInfo.fromPlatform()` throws during startup
- Precondition: Device/platform metadata is unavailable
- Flow: Exception is caught; `appVersion` is set to `'version-unavailable+0'`; bootstrap proceeds normally
- Expected outcome: Reporter is initialized with `metadata['appVersion'] == 'version-unavailable+0'`; handlers are installed; reports are sent
- Edge case of: S-001

### S-003: Platform-originated failure carries full identity
- Trigger: A crash originates in platform native code
- Precondition: Bootstrap has completed in release mode with valid metadata
- Flow: Sentry SDK captures the crash directly (bypasses app `recordError`); SDK applies globally-configured scope tags
- Expected outcome: Report carries `appVersion`, `osVersion`, `deviceModel` identical to what app-code reports carry
- Edge case of: S-001

### S-004: Allow-list contract preserved after identity moves to init
- Trigger: `CrashReportingService.recordError` is called with extra keys
- Precondition: Bootstrap completed; metadata includes the three allowed fields
- Flow: `buildMetadata` is called; extra keys are stripped; cleaned map is forwarded to reporter
- Expected outcome: Reporter receives exactly `{appVersion, osVersion, deviceModel}` — no fourth field
- Edge case of: none

## Iteration 1

### DB Changes
None.

### Backend Changes
1. **`lib/core/services/crash_reporting_service.dart`**
   - `CrashReportingService.bootstrap`: pass `metadata: buildMetadata()` to `reporter.init`.
   - `SentryCrashReporter.init`: after `SentryFlutter.init` completes, call `Sentry.configureScope` to set `appVersion`, `osVersion`, `deviceModel` as SDK-level scope tags.

2. **`lib/main.dart`**
   - Change fallback `appVersion` from `'0.0.0+0'` to `'version-unavailable+0'`.

### Frontend Changes
None.

### Implementation Steps
1. Write failing tests (Phase 0.5 TDD).
2. Update `FakeCrashReporter` to capture metadata passed to `init`.
3. Fix `bootstrap` to forward metadata to `reporter.init`.
4. Fix `SentryCrashReporter.init` to call `Sentry.configureScope` for global tags.
5. Fix fallback version string in `main.dart`.
6. Update existing bootstrap tests to assert identity payload.
7. Run `flutter test` — all green.

## Assumption Log

- Fallback value chosen as `'version-unavailable+0'` — it contains a `+` to satisfy the `version+build` format Sentry expects for `release`, so the event reaches the dashboard without being rejected, but it is visibly not a real version string and is greppable.
